中文功能定位: 独立识别和协调已有模型未知、混合或产品级故障；已知故障域可直接进入专业调试，不重复修复循环。
英文功能定位: Independently route diagnosis or repair of existing Sysplorer model failures when the fault domain is unknown, mixed, or product-wide. Confirmed Modelica faults use ty-physical-model-debugging directly; confirmed Sysblock or CCaller faults use ty-sysblock-model-debugging directly. Exclude ordinary construction, editing, layout, tuning, and pure API help.
